Subject: Follow-up: GDPR DPA & SCC module selection (Acme)

Hi Diana / Tom —

Great to speak today. Quick recap and next steps from our call: 

- Acme will be the Data Controller for customer data; Redwood will be the Data Processor for the hosted inference service. Please confirm if that alignment looks correct on your side.
- You asked for our standard DPA and which SCC module applies. From our side we typically execute the DPA and use the EU Commission SCCs for controller -> processor transfers (Module Two).
- You also asked about SOC 2 and HIPAA posture — attached is a short SOC 2 summary and our redwood DPA (draft).

Requested next steps:
1) Please confirm controller/processor roles for Acme and Redwood.
2) If you want Module Two SCCs (controller -> processor), confirm and we will prepare a Module Two draft attached.
3) If you have a security questionnaire, please send it back and we’ll fill it out (or we can schedule a 30-min tech/security session with one of our Solutions Engineers).
4) We can route the DPA to DocuSign once legal confirms no redlines.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v3.pdf (draft), Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_summary.pdf (summary)

Best,
Rishi
Head of Sales Engineering
Redwood Inference

Thanks Rishi — great call. Quick answers from our side:

- Confirmed: Acme is the Controller and Redwood will be Processor for the hosted inference product.
- We expect controller -> processor SCCs, so Module Two sounds appropriate. Please proceed with a Module Two draft.
- We do have a standard security questionnaire — attaching the current version. Can you have your security team fill it out? If easier, our security team is available for a 30-min walkthrough next week.
- Regarding SOC 2: we need to see the most recent Type II attestation and the coverage period. Also flagging HIPAA: part of our use-case involves PHI, so please call out any HIPAA-specific controls or your willingness to enter a BAA.

Timeline: We will route the questionnaire and the DPA to Legal and InfoSec and aim to get comments by next Friday (2026-07-09).

Thanks,
Diana Ruiz
Security & Privacy Manager
Acme Corp

Thanks Diana — that alignment works for us. A few clarifications and next steps from Redwood: 

- Controller/Processor: we will mark Acme as Controller, Redwood as Processor in the DPA.
- SCC Module: we will prepare a Module Two SCC annex (controller -> processor) and attach a draft (Redwood_SAAS_SCC_Module2_draft.docx).
- SOC 2: Our latest SOC 2 Type II report covers the period 2025-01-01 to 2025-12-31. A redacted attestation summary is attached; we can provide the full report under NDA if needed.
- HIPAA / BAA: We support HIPAA-covered customer deployments and can sign a BAA. For the hosted offering we have controls and subprocessors documented — if you can flag the HIPAA scope (which data flows / environments), Marissa (CC) from our security/compliance team can follow up with the BAA and scope details.

Next steps we propose: 
1) We will upload the DPA and SCC Module Two draft to DocuSign (link below) for your legal to review.
2) Our security team (Marissa) will start answering the questionnaire; if your security team prefers a walk-through, suggest 30-min slots next week.
3) If you require the full SOC 2 report, we can provide it under NDA — please let us know and we will send the NDA template.
